promotion.intro: Promoting shows your Spotlight to more people in their feeds, marked “Sponsored”. You choose a budget and who should see it; we estimate how many people it could reach.
promotion.estimateNote: This is an estimate, not a guarantee. Actual reach depends on how many people in your audience open Spotlight, how often, and what else is being promoted at the same time.
promotion.billingNote: You pay the budget up front. It is used only as your Spotlight is shown as sponsored, and the promotion stops when the budget is used or the run ends, whichever comes first. If it ends before the budget is used, the unused amount is shown on the promotion page.
promotion.reviewNote: Every promotion is reviewed before it runs. If it isn't approved, you're refunded in full.
promotion.cashNote: Paid by card or mobile money. Abonten Credit can't be used for promotions.

estimateBasis.assumed: Based on our planning figures while Spotlight is new.

endReason.run_ended: Run ended before the budget was used

badgeExplanation.place: Abonten reviewed documents supporting this business's registration and its link to the account that manages this listing. Verification is not a guarantee of the business, its service, safety or quality.
badgeExplanation.organizer: Abonten reviewed documents supporting this organizer's identity or registration and their link to this account. Verification is not a guarantee of any event, its delivery, safety or quality.

place.1: A Verified badge shows on your listing, in search results and on the map.
place.2: People are more willing to book and visit a business Abonten has checked.
place.3: Some Abonten programmes, such as promotion credit for visits, are open only to verified places.

organizer.1: A Verified badge shows next to your name on your events and your profile.
organizer.2: Ticket buyers can see that Abonten has checked who is behind the event.
organizer.3: Verification is optional. You can create and publish events without it.

howReviewWorks.1: Submitting documents does not verify you on its own. An Abonten reviewer looks at what you send.
howReviewWorks.2: We may come back and ask for something else before deciding.
howReviewWorks.3: You will get a notification when a decision is made, and the reason if it is not approved.
howReviewWorks.4: Your documents are private. Only Abonten reviewers can open them, and they are deleted once they are no longer needed.

organizerTypeDescription.individual: You organise events in your own name and have no registered company. Send anything that shows the events are really yours, such as a venue booking, an event permit, or flyers and tickets from events you ran.
organizerTypeDescription.business: You run events through a registered company or business name. Send your business registration certificate, and an operating permit or licence if you have one.
organizerTypeDescription.organisation: You organise on behalf of a church, school, NGO, association or similar. Send the body's registration document, plus a letter on its letterhead if you are not the person named on it.

name.description: Shown on your profile so people know who you are.

username.description: Your @handle — it's shown on your reviews and in your profile link. The one you have now was made up for you.

avatar.label: Add a profile photo
avatar.description: Shown on your profile and next to your reviews and messages.

email.label: Add your email
email.description: Needed to pay for tickets and promotions — your tickets and receipts are emailed to you. You can also sign in with a code sent there.

phone.description: Lets you sign in with a code sent by text — a way back in if you can't get into your email or Google account.

most_active.label: Most active launched city
most_active.help: Suggest the launched city with the most upcoming events and places listed in its area (the counts under each city below), marked “Most listings”. A tie goes to the nearer city; if no city has any listings, the nearest is suggested.

fixed.label: A city you choose
fixed.help: Always suggest the city you pick, marked “Suggested”. If it is later made coming soon, deactivated or removed, the nearest launched city is suggested instead.
